variable.name: ANGLE
variable.abstract: It specifies the angle of visualization in thousandth of degree.

description.p: This angle is the one that the interpreter uses to rotate the graph of the process before drawing it in screen. A value of 90000 will rotate the graph 90º to the left. Its value by default is 0 (without rotating).
Optionally it can be combined with the use of for that the graph of process changes according to the angle of visualization.
